result:
I recall this result from Miller, Patzt, and Putman's work on top-dimensional cohomology of congruence subgroups of $\mathrm{SL}_n(\mathbb{Z})$. For $n=3$, the rational top cohomology $H^3(\Gamma_{0,3}^+(p);\mathbb{Q})$ vanishes exactly when $p \in \{2,3,5,7,13\}$ and is nonzero otherwise. I did not re-derive this from the paper, so the set is from memory and not independently verified.

The sum of the primes in the set is
$$2+3+5+7+13 = 30.$$

ANSWER: 30
